disposition.note: Added TC-AD-019-19 (contract test for section 12) and TC-AD-019-20 (boundary test for section 12.7 tables, ASM-3438).
Numbered AC12 as AC11 was taken. Codes 401, 403, 404 as given; the 404 condition is marked Not specified in the source documents.
Numbered AC16 as next free AC. The allowed publish_status changes are marked Not specified in the source documents.
No separate edit for this item: MSG-P1-012 and MSG-P1-001 were aligned to Error and Message Standard v4 under CG-ALL-1871 and CG-ALL-1872.

edits.old:
When the call carries no valid credential, lacks the scope, or names a path the service does not provide

    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 respectively, no row is returned and nothing is written

findings.issue: The new contract and boundary tests reuse TC-AD-019-05 and -06, which already belong to the AC4 and AC5 tests. This breaks TC numbering.
AC12 and TC-14 invent a 'scope' check and a 404 trigger (unprovided path), which also contradicts the Given naming the provided operation.
AC16 relies on a publish status model whose allowed changes are not stated, and the story carries no 'Not specified' marker for them.
Note says no edit was needed for the §14 texts, but MSG-P1-012 and MSG-P1-001 were changed in this diff under CG-ALL-1871 and 1872.
